verdict.rationale: OpenHands is itself the built-in AI assistant/agent: CLI mode lets users type natural language tasks and get instant feedback, resume conversations, and auto-approve actions, and it can run locally, remote, or in the cloud with any LLM. This directly matches delegating tasks to a built-in assistant within the product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating the delegation experience beyond vendor docs, and more detail on task delegation depth (e.g., multi-step autonomy limits).
